4712863.name: Mouhamed Gueye
4712863.short: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

5105571.name: Henri Veesaar
5105571.short: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

4433188.name: Devin Carter
4433188.short: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

5175643.name: Egor Demin
5175643.short: Demin (leg) stated he isn't sure if he will be able to play in Friday's game against Detroit, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

5105626.name: Tyler Bilodeau
5105626.short: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

4395651.name: Coby White
4395651.short: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

5061575.name: Kon Knueppel
5061575.short: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

4066218.name: Grant Williams
4066218.short: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

4684269.name: Kylan Boswell
4684269.short: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

5105555.name: Tobe Awaka
5105555.short: Awaka (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

4431687.name: Patrick Williams
4431687.short: Williams (adductor) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

4278067.name: Nic Claxton
4278067.short: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

5279129.name: Sergio de Larrea
5279129.short: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

4278594.name: Naji Marshall
4278594.short: Marshall (illness) won't play in Wednesday's game against Oklahoma City.

5148538.name: Tarik Biberovic
5148538.short: Biberovic (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

4593125.name: Santi Aldama
4593125.short: Aldama (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

4683688.name: Dereck Lively II
4683688.short: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

3138196.name: Cameron Johnson
3138196.short: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

4592427.name: Spencer Jones
4592427.short: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

4065813.name: Alpha Diallo
4065813.short: Diallo is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to personal reasons.

4432181.name: Julian Strawther
4432181.short: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

4395702.name: Isaiah Joe
4395702.short: Joe (hip) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.

4433621.name: Jalen Duren
4433621.short: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

4997536.name: Gui Santos
4997536.short: Santos has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee tendinitis.

3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis
3102531.short: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

4432171.name: Moses Moody
4432171.short: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

6430.name: Jimmy Butler III
6430.short: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

4871144.name: Alperen Sengun
4871144.short: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

2990992.name: Marcus Smart
2990992.short: Smart (forearm) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

2991235.name: Steven Adams
2991235.short: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

4017837.name: Ivica Zubac
4017837.short: Zubac (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

2530530.name: T.J. McConnell
2530530.short: Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle stated McConnell (hamstring) is "doing better" and "getting closer" to a return, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

4433076.name: Ben Sheppard
4433076.short: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

4396993.name: Tyrese Haliburton
4396993.short: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

5157066.name: Johnny Furphy
5157066.short: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

4066648.name: Rui Hachimura
4066648.short: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

5108024.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
5108024.short: Niederhauser (foot) remains out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers. He also won't travel with the team for the upcoming two-game road trip in Minnesota and Golden State, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

4065778.name: Max Strus
4065778.short: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

3913176.name: Brandon Ingram
3913176.short: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

6580.name: Bradley Beal
6580.short: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

4396818.name: Jordan Miller
4396818.short: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

4433137.name: Ziaire Williams
4433137.short: Williams (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

3945274.name: Luka Doncic
3945274.short: Doncic (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

5113969.name: Cameron Carr
5113969.short: Carr (oblique) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

5060631.name: Adou Thiero
5060631.short: Thiero (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

3899664.name: Simone Fontecchio
3899664.short: Fontecchio (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.

4594268.name: Anthony Edwards
4594268.short: Edwards will undergo arthroscopic right knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

3934673.name: Donte DiVincenzo
3934673.short: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

4277956.name: Jordan Poole
4277956.short: Poole (ankle) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Nuggets. He finished with two points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), one rebound and one steal over seven minutes.

5061589.name: Yves Missi
5061589.short: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

4277869.name: Jose Alvarado
4277869.short: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls.

4433255.name: Chet Holmgren
4433255.short: Holmgren (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

4593803.name: Jalen Williams
4593803.short: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

2991350.name: Alex Caruso
2991350.short: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5061603.name: Thomas Sorber
5061603.short: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

5159925.name: Nikola Topic
5159925.short: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

4683692.name: Cason Wallace
4683692.short: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4065654.name: Jonathan Isaac
4065654.short: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

4432165.name: Jalen Suggs
4432165.short: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4432573.name: Paolo Banchero
4432573.short: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

5214637.name: Noah Penda
5214637.short: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

5107251.name: Izaiyah Nelson
5107251.short: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

4432446.name: Jabari Walker
4432446.short: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.

3904625.name: Tacko Fall
3904625.short: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.

4870562.name: Dominick Barlow
4870562.short: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

4871141.name: Ariel Hukporti
4871141.short: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4601023.name: Oso Ighodaro
4601023.short: Ighodaro (oblique) is feeling better and considered day-to-day ahead of Friday's game against the Nuggets, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

4701232.name: Mark Williams
4701232.short: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4706557.name: Chris Youngblood
4706557.short: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

4914336.name: Shaedon Sharpe
4914336.short: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4433174.name: Dylan Cardwell
4433174.short: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4898371.name: Maxime Raynaud
4898371.short: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4594327.name: Keegan Murray
4594327.short: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

3907387.name: Ben Simmons
3907387.short: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

6440.name: Tobias Harris
6440.short: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Utah, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.

5101845.name: Jayden Quaintance
5101845.short: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4432586.name: Nate Bittle
4432586.short: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

6450.name: Kawhi Leonard
6450.short: Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4066336.name: Lauri Markkanen
4066336.short: Markkanen (wrist) is out for Wednesday's tilt against the Spurs.

4277961.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
4277961.short: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4433268.name: Trey Alexander
4433268.short: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic
3102530.short: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

5238230.name: Tre Johnson
5238230.short: Johnson has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers due to right Achilles soreness.

4432907.name: Justin Champagnie
4432907.short: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

4997537.name: Tristan Vukcevic
4997537.short: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

4606840.name: Jamir Watkins
4606840.short: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
